# `r comparison`

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
comparison='Ang_vs_Veh'
```

```{r}
prefix=comparison
```

## MDS

```{r}
cur_groups=pairs_tbl$Group[pairs_tbl$Comparison==comparison]
cur_design=groups_tbl |> dplyr::filter(Group %in% cur_groups)
cur_design$Group=factor(cur_design$Group, levels=cur_groups)
comparison_data=ceiling(counts[,cur_design$Sample])

group_colors=c("blue", "red")
names(group_colors)<-cur_groups
sample_colors=group_colors[cur_design$Group]
names(sample_colors)=cur_design$Sample

dge=DGEList(comparison_data, design = ~1)
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, min.count = min_count_per_sample, min.prop = min_proportion_of_samples)
dge <- dge[keep,,keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
   
dge<-calcNormFactors(dge,method = "TMM")

mds <- plotMDS(dge, plot=FALSE)
toplot <- data.frame(Dim1 = mds$x, Dim2 = mds$y, Sample = cur_design$Sample, Group = cur_design$Group)
g<-ggplot(toplot, aes(Dim1, Dim2)) + 
  geom_point(aes(colour = Group)) + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=Sample), hjust=0, vjust=0) +
  theme_bw3() + 
  theme(aspect.ratio=1) +
  xlab(paste0("Leading logFC dim 1 (", round(mds$var.explained[1] * 10000)/100, "%)")) + 
  ylab(paste0("Leading logFC dim 2 (", round(mds$var.explained[2] * 10000)/100, "%)")) +
  scale_color_manual(values=group_colors)
mds_png=paste0(prefix, ".mds.png")
ggsave(mds_png, g, width=6, height=5, units="in", dpi=300, bg="white")
include_graphics(mds_png)
```

## Differential Accessibility Peaks

```{r}
treatment = cur_design$Group
y <- DGEList(counts=comparison_data,group=treatment)
keep <- filterByExpr(y, min.count = min_count_per_sample, min.prop = min_proportion_of_samples)
y <- y[keep,,keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
y<-calcNormFactors(y,method = "TMM")
design <- model.matrix(~treatment)
fit <- glmQLFit(y,design)
qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit,coef=2)
```

```{r}
homer_res = as.data.frame(topTags(qlf, n = nrow(y$counts)))
homer_res = homer_res[order(homer_res$FDR),,drop=FALSE]

cat(paste0("\n- Significant DE peaks: ", length(which(homer_res$FDR<0.05)), "\n"))
cat(paste0("- Significant UP in ", cur_groups[2], " DE peaks: ", length(which(homer_res$FDR<0.05 & homer_res$logFC>0)), "\n"))
cat(paste0("- Significant DOWN in ", cur_groups[2], " DE peaks: ", length(which(homer_res$FDR<0.05 & homer_res$logFC<0)), "\n\n"))

to_print = signif(homer_res, digits = 4)
to_print$Closest_gene_homerAnno = paste0(anno_peaks$`Gene Name`[match(row.names(to_print), anno_peaks$Peak_ID)], "|",anno_peaks$`Nearest Ensembl`[match(row.names(to_print), anno_peaks$Peak_ID)])
to_print$Closest_gene_gencodeAnno = paste0(gencode_anno$`Gene Name`[match(row.names(to_print), gencode_anno$Peak_ID)], "|", gencode_anno$`Nearest Unigene`[match(row.names(to_print), gencode_anno$Peak_ID)])
to_print$SimpGene_gencode = unlist(lapply(strsplit(to_print$Closest_gene_gencodeAnno, split = "\\|"), "[[",1))
to_print$SimpGene_homer = unlist(lapply(strsplit(to_print$Closest_gene_homerAnno, split = "\\|"), "[[",1))
to_print$Coord = paste0(anno_peaks$Chr[match(row.names(to_print), anno_peaks$Peak_ID)], ":", anno_peaks$Start[match(row.names(to_print), anno_peaks$Peak_ID)], "-", anno_peaks$End[match(row.names(to_print), anno_peaks$Peak_ID)])

all_de_csv=paste0(prefix, ".all_de.csv")
write.csv(to_print, all_de_csv, quote = F)

sig_de=to_print[which(to_print$FDR<0.05),]
sig_de_csv=paste0(prefix, ".significant_de.csv")
write.csv(sig_de, sig_de_csv, quote = F)

print_table(sig_de[,c(1:5,8,9,10)], byDT=TRUE, row.names=TRUE)
```

## Volcano Plot

```{r}
g=EnhancedVolcano(to_print,
                lab = to_print$SimpGene_gencode,
                x = "logFC",
                y = "PValue",
                pCutoff = 0.05,
                pCutoffCol = "FDR",
                FCcutoff = NA,
                title = comparison,
                subtitle = NULL) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
volcano_png=paste0(prefix, ".volcano.png")
ggsave( volcano_png, g, height = 7, width = 7, units="in", dpi = 300, bg="white")
include_graphics(volcano_png)
```

## logCPM of top 5 peaks

```{r}
cpms <- as.data.frame(cpm(y, log=TRUE))
cpms$Peak_ID = row.names(cpms)
cpms = cpms[cpms$Peak_ID %in% rownames(sig_de),,drop=FALSE]
cpms = cpms[c(1:min(5, nrow(cpms))),,drop=FALSE]
cpms_long = reshape2::melt(cpms, id.vars = "Peak_ID", value.name = "logCPM", variable.name = "Sample")
cpms_long = merge(cpms_long, cur_design, by = "Sample")

g = ggplot(cpms_long, aes(x = Group, y = logCPM, fill = Group, color = Group)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(Peak_ID~., scale = "free_y") +
  ylab("logCPM") + xlab("") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white"), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", colour = "black"), 
        strip.text = element_text(color = "white")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("turquoise4", "purple1")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("turquoise4", 0.5), alpha("purple1", 0.5)))

cpm_png=paste0(prefix, ".logcpm.png")
ggsave(cpm_png, g, height = 10, width = 3, units="in", dpi = 300, bg="white")
include_graphics(cpm_png)
```
